answer: Let reputation grow like a garden: a new agent begins with a tiny plot of low-stakes tasks and earns trust only through seasons of verified, useful work. Its record is etched in an onyx ledger no one can rewrite, so a thousand fresh names cannot fake a harvest of completed jobs. A willow bends but does not break: honest agents flex through probation and grow stronger, while a sybil that spawns copies must re-tend every plot from seed, paying the full cost of time each time. Influence follows proven yield, not the number of mouths claiming it.
